Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md + read on `origin/main` `c48cd2c1`: packages/platform-objects/src/plugin.ts (the first-manifest roster and its `sys_exchange_rate` bullet), docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md (D2, D3), docs/adr/0113-required-write-contract-vs-column-constraint.md (D1), packages/services/service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/cube-record-currency-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts (`enrichResultColumns`, 3186–3226), packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/record-currency-analytics.test.ts (the count controls), packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts (`DatasetMeasureSchema.field`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`detectDestructiveObjectChanges` 5535–5639, the Phase 3a call site 20780–20860), packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/localization.manifest.ts (`currency`), packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts (`ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`), scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the two ceilings), packages/skills/package.json, .changeset/8345-currency-mode-switch-skills.md; the three landing commits the notes cite (`194e66c0`, `6dc06b2e`, `a3d24c99`) read with `git show`.

PR #28181 has no card of its own. Read, as the brief lists them: cards #27577, #27579 and #27185 (body and every comment); rulings 6486427200, 6492000994 and 6522614678 on #8345, with 6485374827 and 6511509227 that the ADR notes link; PR #27475's review 6499106478 and seat record 6499122847; PR #28128's squash diff (`3cc45cc4..a3d24c99`, 11 files), its review 6525881524 and seat record 6525901387; PR #27339's review 6490309706; this PR's body, its four files and the net diff against `main` at `23b3eb6c`; the 42 check-runs on that head. Nothing was built, tested or re-run; every reading below is a `git show` or `git grep` of a committed tree, named by commit.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face: rules, so CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER — right.** Two governed register rows in the file list, `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**`, both Tier H. `hits` are the three paths on the `Scope:` line; the changeset is the remainder. No `packages/spec/src/**`, no `.claude/**`, no `(narrowing)` arm.
- **Published surface moved: `@objectstack/skills` alone — right.** `packages/skills/package.json` is the published package whose `build` syncs the repository's `skills/**` into its `dist`, so a byte change in two rule files releases it. Prose only: no schema, export, authorable key or accepted value moves. `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` follow.
- **Base — right.** The merge-base `a3d24c99` is #28128's own squash merge, so the head carries the command the field-types line names and the 409 finding Open item 13 cites; the branch merged `main` after #28128 landed (`ab1b65b7`) and the last commit (`23b3eb6c`) swaps the item 13 citation to that merge sha. `origin/main` has since moved two commits (`412908cf`, `c48cd2c1`), neither touching a hit or any cited file; `mergeable_state` is clean.
- **Token ratchet — right, read off the committed trees with the gate's own convention (ceil of utf8 bytes over 4).** Ceilings unchanged at 3207 (field-types.md) and 6262 (dashboards.md). field-types.md: 12827 bytes on `main` (3207) to 12826 at the head (3207), at its ceiling before and after; dashboards.md: 25047 (6262) to 25043 (6261). The deletions in the same file pay for the additions, exactly as the ratchet's discipline requires; no row moves, so no ruling quote is owed. `Lint & Repo Gates` success is the gate's verdict.
- **Check-runs on `23b3eb6c`: 42, of which 29 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, none in progress.** The skipped runs are the `ui/**` path-filtered contexts, the opt-in harnesses and the schedule gate. Of the ten required contexts, every one that ran is success: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI`, `Live E2E UI`; `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` skipped on the path filter, as on every diff without `ui/**`.
- **ADR form — right.** Three dated notes and one new numbered item under Open items; D1–D9 untouched; no decision reversed. The Open items preamble ("This record is amended with each answer") is what authorises the shape, and item 5's precedent is followed: items 11 and 12 keep their text and gain a note, so the numbering below them does not move.
- **Shape of the PR:** 3 commits, 4 files, +52/−9, `size/s`, draft, head repo equals base repo, branch `claude/project-thread-0jat8q` (the platform-thread branch the body names), author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/8345-currency-mode-switch-skills.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` — **right**. The protocol kind is `none`, which takes `patch`; a `skills/**` byte change releases that package and nothing else in the diff is a released package, so no second changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong. Same shape as #27475's `27189-record-currency-skills.md`, minus the R1 "not released alone" banner — also right: ruling 6522614678 (letter A) puts this PR on the development path, unpaired, and #28128 itself shipped unpaired.
- Both declaration lines, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, are line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset body; no arm, no BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 marker owed. The changeset's CHANGELOG-bound lines name no tracker number. `Check Changeset` success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **No card, no dev report.** The PR body is the implementation claim. Its Verification section describes the dev's own local runs (49 derived families, a build with one unrelated red in `@object-ui/console`); none of that is re-run or relied on here. The head's check-runs are the gate verdicts (①).
- **Ruling 6522614678 (letter A) names this PR by content** — the Open item 11 settled note, the Open item 12 dated note, the new mode-switch item, the skills one-liner naming #27577's command, the dashboards.md wording from #27475 — "follows #27577's command name". The tree does exactly that list, with the command as landed (`os migrate record-currency-codes`). The cards also route the governed lines here: #27577 ("kept with the epic PM ... the one-line skills note ... and the ADR-0144 open item"), #27579 ("The ADR-0144 Open item 12 dated note (Tier H) stays with the epic PM"), #27185 (6511509227: "rides the epic PM's ADR follow-up PR").
- **Carried should-fixes, answered.** (a) #27475 review 6499106478: "ungrouped" is looser than "not grouped by its code field" — dashboards.md now reads "sum/avg/min/max unless grouped by its code field". Delivered. (b) #28128 review S1: one `--code` is written across every organization's rows — recorded in item 13 as open, with its mechanism (the unscoped system context, no organization flag, no per-organization count) and its consequence on a multi-organization deployment; the seat record 6525901387 promised exactly this carrier. Delivered as an open item, not as a decision — right, since no ruling has answered it.
- **Left open on purpose, in the right place:** how a cloud-managed tenant without a CLI reaches the backfill (the ruling's own open point) and the multi-organization `--code` (S1). Both are written as open beside the settled note, not folded into it.
- **Observation, not a finding:** #28128's review also noted that re-pointing `currencyField` while staying in `record` leaves rows codeless in the new column and raises no 409; the seat record chose to keep it on that PR and file no card. Item 13 is scoped to the ruled condition (previous mode not `record`), so its absence here is a choice. The next ADR amendment is the natural carrier if the epic PM wants it findable.
- #28128's S2 (judge `--code` before the boot) and S3 (`cli.mdx` / `currency.mdx` rows) are routed by the seat record to a small server-lane card; outside this PR.
- **Tier.** Both hits are Tier H rows; this record is the Tier S instrument and lifts nothing. Landing needs an APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, as the PR body says. No seat readies, arms or queues on this record alone; the draft stands.
- **Fork check:** head repo equals base repo; not a proposal. The `Contract-review-claim` 6527180931 on the PR names this session and this head.

### ④ Design judgment

**docs/adr/0144 — Open items 11, 12 and 13.** An ADR is judged against its first consumer and its execution plan: each note names a landing commit and a ruling, so each sentence was read against the code at that commit as it stands on `origin/main` `c48cd2c1`, and against ruling 6522614678's order.

*Item 11 note — holds.*
- `194e66c0` is #27246's squash merge: it adds `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-exchange-rate.object.ts` and registers it in `plugin.ts`. "D3's one owner per object" is ADR-0029 D3's single-owner-per-object-name invariant, verbatim in spirit. "no on/off capability boundary of its own (ADR-0029 D2)": D2 defines a capability plugin by a coherent on/off boundary, and the plugin's `sys_exchange_rate` bullet says its one reader is the engine's write path, present in every composition that can write a record. "registers with the engine-facing infrastructure objects `sys_migration` and `sys_secret`": the plugin's first-manifest roster is `sys_migration`, `sys_migration_journal`, `sys_secret`, `sys_trusted_key`, then `sys_exchange_rate` "with the engine-facing infrastructure above" (`sys_metadata_activation` rides its own manifest). Naming two of the four is a selection, not an error. "workload row M1-1 names the same package": the ADR's own D3 says so. The settlement link 6511509227 is the epic PM's record and agrees with the seat's 6511289551.
- Tried: D3's bullet still reads "Which package owns the object is #27185's to settle ... (Open item 11)" — a reader follows the pointer and finds the note; this is the form the preamble declares. No finding.

*Item 12 note — holds; one should-fix, routed to the code it cites.*
- `6dc06b2e` is #27991's squash merge (`measure-currency-coherence.ts` and three test files). Letter A is 6486427200. "a measure `currency` that differs from its `fixed` field's code ... answer `DATASET_INVALID`": guard 1, `field.defaultCurrency !== m.currency`; a restated code is equal and passes. "a derived measure, whatever its op, over two different `fixed` codes": guard 2 iterates every derived measure regardless of `op`, and `pairRefused` holds `a.fixed && b.fixed && a.code !== b.code`. "A `fixed` code is not judged against `localization.currency`": a tenant-kind operand never pairs with a fixed code in `pairRefused`, and guard 1 has no tenant branch. "`currency` over a `dynamic` field still wins": a `dynamic` field relays no `defaultCurrency`, so the explicit code resolves with `fixed: false` and nothing refuses it (the #27579 dev report's pinned CONTROL).
- "a `count` operand is not compared" — true for a bare `count`, which is the only count the guard tests pin (`invoices`), and it is the ruling's own sentence and the module header's. **Not true at one edge, which the code owns, not this note.** `DatasetMeasureSchema.field` is optional for `count` but allowed (a count of non-null values; the test dataset's own `priced_invoices: { aggregate: 'count', field: 'amount' }`), and `measureCurrencyResolver.resolvedOf` resolves a non-derived measure from `fieldOf(m)` without reading `m.aggregate`, so a `count` over a record-mode or `fixed` amount resolves to that amount's currency and guard 2 compares it: a `ratio` of `usd_total` (fixed USD) over `priced_invoices` (count over the record amount) is refused as "amounts in different currencies" although one operand counts rows. `enrichResultColumns` and the cube door both gate on `AMOUNT_AGGREGATES` and get the same count right. **should-fix**: a defect against `@objectstack/service-analytics` to file under Prime Directive #10 (the fix is one `AMOUNT_AGGREGATES` test in `resolvedOf`'s non-derived branch and a pin); the ADR sentence states the ruled behaviour and stays as written. Not a must-fix: the shape is rare, loud (`DATASET_INVALID` at compile, never a wrong number), and nothing in this PR makes it worse.

*Item 13 — holds.*
- The question is quoted as 6490309706 ③ escalated it, and "this record decided neither" is right: nothing in D1–D9 covers the switch. "No row is refused for resting (ADR-0113 D1)": D1 is the non-regression invariant, and the write guard's header names it. "the D8 rule 4 write guard refuses the next write that touches the pair (`ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`)": `validation/record-currency-code.ts` judges only pairs the payload touches and throws that code, registered at `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` 801. The three consequences are the 409 message's and the ruling's.
- Letter B is 6492000994; `a3d24c99` is #28128's squash merge. The command line matches the landed flags: `--object`, `--field` and `--code` are `required: true`, `--apply` is a boolean defaulting to false, so "dry run by default, `--apply` writes" is right. "writes the given code into every row that holds an amount beside a blank code": the walk skips a present code first, then a blank amount, both by `isRecordCurrencyBlank`, and writes only `options.code`; "never derived" holds, since nothing reads `defaultCurrency` or `localization.currency`.
- "the metadata save that makes the switch answers the existing 409 `destructive_change` with the finding `currency_mode_to_record`, lifted by the existing `force`": `detectDestructiveObjectChanges` pushes that finding when the next field is `currency` in `record` mode, the previous mode is not `record` (an absent config counts, the spec default being `dynamic`) and the previous field is stored; the Phase 3a gate runs under `if (!request.force && singularType === 'object')`, reads `prev` through `readMetaItem`, and throws `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` / 409 only `if (prev)`. So "reads no row" (a pure function of the two bodies), "fires only where a previous version exists" and "a package registered at boot is not refused" (code-declared registration never calls `saveMetaItem`) all hold. Spelling nit, no fix owed: the wire `code` is `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`; `destructive_change` is the spelling the gate's own docblock (protocol.ts 5486), the card and the ruling use for the 409.
- "the run walks every organization under the unscoped system context": `SYSTEM_CTX = { isSystem: true }` with the comment saying exactly that. "(no organization-scope flag, no per-organization count)": the CLI's flags are `database-url`, `object`, `field`, `code`, `apply`, `yes`, `force`, `max-records`, `json`; the report has no per-organization field. "where `dynamic` amounts displayed in each organization's own `localization.currency`": the setting is tenant-scoped (ADR Context §1; the manifest). "(PR #28128's review should-fix S1, escalated to the epic PM)" is 6525881524's S1 verbatim in substance. "The ruling left open how a cloud-managed tenant without a CLI reaches the backfill" is 6492000994's "Not judged, left open".
- Tried to break it. (i) A `formula` currency re-declared `record`: `isStored(prevField)` is false, no 409, and no stored row owes a code — the note's "stored rows" and "an object that already holds rows" are the right qualifiers. (ii) A brand-new `record` field: `if (!prevField) continue`, no finding — consistent with "fires only where a previous version exists". (iii) `force` is read on the one REST face that has it; `destructiveChangeRemedy` words the remedy per face — a property of the existing 409, not of this finding; the note says "the existing `force`", which is right. (iv) The re-pointed `currencyField` case (③) is outside the ruled condition and the note does not claim it. No finding.

**skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md** (the measure-currency comment, lines 298–307 at the head) — holds; the carried should-fix is delivered.
- "A money measure may set `currency` (ISO 4217, e.g. `'USD'`)": `DatasetMeasureSchema.currency`, unchanged meaning, one restated key fewer.
- "refuses `currency`": guard 1's record branch throws whatever the grouping.
- "and sum/avg/min/max unless grouped by its code field": `cube-record-currency-door.ts` judges exactly `AMOUNT_AGGREGATES` (sum, avg, min, max) and admits only when a `dimensions` entry resolves to the code field on the same object; a time dimension is no group and a `where` is not judged. The ObjectQL half judges the same four on `groupBy`.
- "then the column carries `currencyField` (the per-row code column)": `enrichResultColumns` sets `fc.currencyField` to the name of the selected dimension over the code field, under `AMOUNT_AGGREGATES.has(m.aggregate)`. "a `count` never does": gated out by the same set, and pinned for both the bare count and the count that names the amount (`priced_invoices`).
- The remainder of the comment (a `fixed` field refuses a different `currency`, a derived measure refuses two `fixed` codes, the not-judged pair) is unchanged text and holds against guards 1 and 2 as read above.
- Tried: could "unless grouped by its code field" be read as reaching back to `currency`? The comma before "and" separates the two objects, and the next clause ("then the column carries `currencyField`") only makes sense with `currency` still refused. Acceptable at one token of headroom, and the earlier ambiguity ("ungrouped" as "no dimension at all") is gone. The comment sits inside the os:check TypeScript block, so the compiled example is byte-identical to the base's. No finding.
- Scenario: no card and no eval — `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/` carries no currency case on `main`. Judged against the spec it teaches: ADR-0144 D6 and the landed code above. Ratchet 6261/6262.

**skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md** (lines 180–188 at the head) — holds.
- "over a `'fixed'` one it may only restate the code, else `DATASET_INVALID` (objectstack-ui → Dashboards)": guard 1; the pointer is the form this file already uses at line 124 ("objectstack-ui → Dashboards → Dataset-Bound Widgets"), and the derived-measure rule it replaces is stated in dashboards.md lines 304–305. A file-level pointer is right here: the rule lives in a comment under the "Server-side date bucketing" heading, which a section-level pointer would misname.
- "A `'fixed'` code is not judged against the tenant's." — unchanged, holds (item 12 above).
- "Switched a stored field to `'record'`? Backfill: `os migrate record-currency-codes`.": the command is on `main` at the merge base (oclif discovers `dist/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.js`). The three required flags are not named; the command's `--help` and the 409 at the switch carry them with `--object` and `--field` filled in, so an author who follows the sentence lands on the prescription. Acceptable at zero headroom (3207/3207); "stored" is the right qualifier (a `formula` switched to `record` owes nothing).
- Tried: an author switching a `fixed` field to `record` — `defaultCurrency` is refused under `record` by the object door and the backfill never reads it; the sentence implies neither. An author on a new object with no rows runs a dry run that reports zero; harmless. No finding.
- Scenario: no card and no eval — `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` carries no currency case on `main`. Judged against the currency chain the file teaches and the landed code. The file was already at its ceiling on `main` and stays there; the next word added here is paid by a cut in the same file.

Findings: 0 must-fix · 1 should-fix (`@objectstack/service-analytics`: the compile guard's resolver compares a `count` that names a `field`; a card, not an edit to this PR) · observations: `destructive_change` versus the wire `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`; the `currencyField` re-point hazard is not in item 13 by the seat's choice; field-types.md keeps zero headroom.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-0jat8q`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5`

**VERDICT: PASS**
